issues.description: The template repository has inconsistent definitions for the fixed-point word size (FIX_LEN) between the example program and the tests. The example_program code defines FIX_LEN as 8 (64-bit fix_t) while the tests define FIX_LEN as 4 (32-bit fix_t). This mismatch means students may build/execute example and test code with different fix_t sizes, causing calling-convention and value-size mismatches (assembly routines and C prototypes expect different argument layouts) and leading to confusing failures or undefined behaviour.
issues.suggestedFix: Make FIX_LEN consistent across all parts of the template. Either change tests/src/math_fix.h to #define FIX_LEN 8 to match example_program, or change example_program's fix definitions to use FIX_LEN 4 — whichever matches the intended assignment. Update any documentation to state the required FIX_LEN and ensure both example_program and tests use the same value so assembly calling conventions and fix_t typedefs align.
